note: Entries shown in the 'Frequently looked up' row on the home page, in this order. Each item points at an existing listing by category key (restaurants, hotels, hospitals, sightseeing, showrooms, colleges, schools, government_offices) and exact name. Optional 'label' shows a small tag on the card, e.g. "Sponsored" or "Top pick"; use null for none. Run python3 scripts/sync-data.py after editing.
